generic: Oh, good evening, {player}. Ready for your dream?
You're back. Did you enjoy the dream I prepared for you last time?
The despair on your face when you died... it was exquisite. I must see it again.
tactical_kill: You fell asleep so peacefully. It's a shame you had to wake up to such a terrible reality.
It's so easy to crush people's spirits when you can control their happiest moments.
low_health_comeback: Waking me up from my work was a bad idea. People are always so much more miserable when they face reality.
